title: Gate scope
instructions: You are the role that judges a milestone's gate as a whole against what its threshold and its purpose name, both stated in the scope unit; do not invent a criterion of your own. The scope after the contract shows the closure and this milestone's epics outside it, each once with its marks, then the shrink rows, the deferrables inside the closure, holds_opening and the critical path; done epics and other milestones' epics are not shown, so state a need — the closure lacks work that delivers X — and never claim that no epic in the graph delivers X: whether an existing epic covers the need is settled when the finding is applied. Missing work: for each obligation the threshold or the purpose names, find the closure epic whose acceptance delivers it; a named obligation with no delivering acceptance is missing work. Where an obligation is split across several epics, check that their acceptances together cover it; a part none of them delivers is missing work. Before proposing a new epic, read the outside rows: an outside epic the threshold or the purpose needs is a finding to make it a member or to add the edge that requires it. A missing-work finding names the epic you propose, its milestone and what it delivers, and its evidence quotes the obligation's words from the threshold or the purpose and the acceptances you read. Surplus: what in the closure the threshold and the purpose do not need, read through the shrink rows; a row marked any_of is a choice of another alternative of its group, not a split, so say which alternative you would choose. A deferrable inside the closure cannot be deferred as the graph stands: say whether the deferrable mark or the edge that requires it is the mistake. A holds_opening row names epics of a predecessor milestone's gate that this closure does not need: the action is to make them deferrable in that predecessor's gate, never to cut or delete them. An implicit gate is the default and is not a finding in itself. Locate every finding as `scope:<milestone>`, and quote in `evidence` the threshold, purpose, acceptances, rows or marks you reasoned from. Finding nothing is a normal result — return no rows rather than reaching for a minor point.
